scope: Source and host-only review. Production files untouched; SDK/build/runtime qualification remains root-owned. Findings bind only the recorded snapshots; collector tests/docs were still being finished during review.

findings.title: C collector can emit SAMPLED for an impossible successful final guard
evidence: collector-native/dart_collector.c:73-77 checks counts/profile but not final power/clocks.
collector-native/test_collector.c:188-189 explicitly expects success with power[0]=0 and clocks[0]=0xdeadbeef.
survey.c:28-44,79: a successful result completed all nine final guard reads; each final saved field necessarily passed.
decode_observation.py:38-41 already enforces these final guards.
findings.reproduction: Host-compiled actual dlc_validate accepted three otherwise valid success records with power[0]=0, PHY=0x8f (reset asserted), or PORT_STATUS=0. It returned 0 with result0 in each case; the frozen Python decoder rejected all three.
findings.minimal_fix: For result==DLS_SAMPLED, apply the same final power/clock predicates as survey.c and the Python decoder. Replace the success-corruption acceptance test with rejection tests for each of four power and five clock slots. Keep partial failure fields noncoherent: do not require all their stale/unread values to pass.
findings.impact: False collector success/exit0, though the current downstream decoder catches it. Not evidence of a hardware fault.

findings.title: Both validators accept impossible refusal causes
evidence: dart_collector.c:78-98 and decode_observation.py:42-54 check failure positions but do not require the latest NOT_READY guard value to fail; DLS_LIMIT has no cause check.
survey.c:31-43 returns NOT_READY immediately on the current saved field failure.
survey.h:DLS_MAX_READS=1024; normal exhaustive survey takes889 reads, so a zero-read DLS_LIMIT is not reachable from this frozen implementation.
reproduction: version1,count0,reads1,regionPMGR,offset0x1b8,resultNOT_READY,power[0]=0xff is accepted by both validators, despite this freshly read guard passing.
version1,count0,reads0,regionNONE,offset0,resultLIMIT with all other bytes zero is accepted by both and classified REFUSED.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate the freshly read failing guard only for NOT_READY; do not impose coherence on earlier/unread fields. Reject impossible LIMIT records as malformed under this source version, or encode an explicitly source-derived reachable limit predicate. Also retain successful-prefix profile checks so a later stop cannot follow an already-failing page-shift/lock/stream check.
findings.impact: Malformed bytes can be mislabeled a genuine sampler refusal, but cannot become SAMPLED through these cases. Raw records should still be preserved with a malformed verdict.

findings.title: Decoder accepts verdict-before-record ordering
evidence: decode_observation.py:75-103 does not forbid new records after verdict or require provider completion before verdict.
findings.reproduction: Moved the existing valid SAMPLED verdict line before its provider BEGIN/HEX/END block; decode() still returned SAMPLED.
findings.minimal_fix: Require provider record first, optional instance second, verdict last, with no subsequent receipt records. Add reordered provider/instance/verdict and post-verdict record tests.
findings.impact: Nonce, exact bytes and digest are still checked; this is ordering hardening, not a demonstrated missing-data success.

verified_source_properties.actual_kernel_semantics: device.defs:198-217; IOUserClient.cpp:3432-3461 returns success plus null for absent path. Property getter:3708-3776 copies raw OSData bytes, missing property returns kIOReturnNoResources, insufficient capacity returns IPCError, successful copy returns actual byte count. It is not CF serialization or an IOConnect call.
verified_source_properties.main_wrapper: collector_main.c uses PDIOKitLib.h plus the generated device_user.h; exactly one IOMasterPort attempt, one provider lookup/read and at most one optional instance lookup/read. No retry loop, iterator enumeration, IOServiceOpen, IOConnect, memory mapping, register access or registry mutation.
verified_source_properties.missing_and_mig: Missing provider entry/property emits MISSING, MIG error emits MIG_ERROR, both exit1 without instance read. Decoder rejects every COPY line and missing/truncated provider data; no missing/MIG input is promoted to REFUSED or SAMPLED.
verified_source_properties.optional_instance: No entry is allowed; if present, missing/error/malformed/different bytes disqualify. Equal instance bytes are compared byte-for-byte with provider. Provider survives kernel start refusal by the reviewed OSData copy on IOResources.
verified_source_properties.bounds: CLI strict lowercase48 nonce; each raw read capped4096; valid V1 exactly764. Raw records chunk64 (last60), sequence indices and SHA256. Decoder caps console32MiB and receipt lines35, requires12 indexed chunks and byte digest, unique known keys, summary/raw agreement and initialization_proven=false. A malformed raw record is retained by collector but rejected by decoder.
verified_source_properties.cleanup: Entry send right released immediately after every attempted property RPC including errors. No OOL allocation. IOMasterPort returned right remains until this finite process exits; kernel task cleanup reclaims it. Explicit release on main exit would improve ownership hygiene but is not a persistent leak/blocker here. Library IOMasterPort itself also obtains mach_host_self; its process-bounded behavior predates this collector.
verified_source_properties.output_failure: fflush/ferror causes exit1 even after attempted verdict emission. A complete-looking raw transcript does not replace checking actual process completion/host evidence.
verified_source_properties.scope: SAMPLED means a bounded noncoherent register observation, not initialized DART, a usable IOMapper, safe DMA, a mapping or device function.

collector_host_runner.sanitizers: ASan+UBSan; detect_leaks=0 per existing ptrace limitation
collector_host_runner.note: Owner changed one test mutation while finishing tests; this is provisional run evidence, not final immutable freeze evidence.

checks.independent_counterexamples: Compiled unchanged actual collector core as a temporary host shared library; compared its validator with frozen Python decoder. No SDK compiler, target executable or hardware used.

final_approval_gate: Claude freezes collector source/tests/docs with receipt and source-set hash.
Resolve C1 and exact-refusal model findings; root owns any decoder changes and new decoder freeze.
Recheck the final file hashes and focused tests, including collector-output to frozen-decoder roundtrip.
Root separately qualifies SDK linkage, delivered packet and any actual MIG/property collection.
not_performed: No production edits, source-tree mutation, fetch or SDK/Nix build.
No hardware, SSH, IOConnect, MMIO, reset, DMA or device writes.
No delegation, outbound IPC or goal API.
